youtube.baslik: Does noise reduction make speech in noise easier to understand? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Digital noise reduction lowers gain in channels where noise dominates, but because speech and noise in the same channel drop together, it cannot change the signal-to-noise ratio within a channel. Studies show more listening comfort, while speech understanding usually does not change clearly.
